metadata.question: Between January 29 and February 5, 2019, was there at least a 22 degree Celcius difference in the highest daily air temperature at 2 meters in Boston, MA?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need air temperature at 2 meters data - ERA5-Land hourly data has temperature_2m - Date range: January 29 to February 5, 2019 - Location: Boston, MA (approximately 42.36°N, 71.06°W) - Need to find the maximum daily temperature for each day, then find the difference between highest and lowest max temps 2. Masking strategy: - No masking needed for ERA5-Land reanalysis data (no clouds) - Just need to extract temperature values 3. Logic: - Get daily maximum temperatures for each day in the period - Find the highest and lowest of these daily maxima - Calculate difference - If difference >= 22°C, answer A; otherwise B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const boston = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.06, 42.36]); const startDate = '2019-01-29'; const endDate = '2019-02-06'; // Inclusive of Feb 5 // 2. Data Acquisition const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(boston) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total hourly images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No ERA5-Land data found for the period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Process daily maximum temperatures // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius and get daily max const dailyMaxTemps = []; const days = ['2019-01-29', '2019-01-30', '2019-01-31', '2019-02-01', '2019-02-02', '2019-02-03', '2019-02-04', '2019-02-05']; for (let day of days) { const nextDay = ee.Date(day).advance(1, 'day').format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); const dayCol = era5.filterDate(day, nextDay); const daySize = dayCol.size().getInfo(); if (daySize === 0) { console.log(`No data for ${day}`); continue; } // Get max temperature for the day const maxImg = dayCol.max(); const maxTemp = maxImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: boston, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined) { console.log(`Failed to get temperature for ${day}`); continue; } const maxTempC = maxTemp - 273.15; dailyMaxTemps.push(maxTempC); console.log(`${day}: Max temp = ${maxTempC.toFixed(2)}°C`); } // 4. Validation & Calculation if (dailyMaxTemps.length === 0) { console.log('No valid temperature data extracted.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const highestMax = Math.max(...dailyMaxTemps); const lowestMax = Math.min(...dailyMaxTemps); const difference = highestMax - lowestMax; console.log(`\nHighest daily max: ${highestMax.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Lowest daily max: ${lowestMax.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Difference: ${difference.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 5. Final Answer if (difference >= 22.0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
